files.note: Part 0 reads the manifests only. The distance files are hashed (bytes) and opened by no code before this lock is committed.

stimuli.excluded_why: Remy's conventions (fly_counts_stim_rdm_concat.csv: 'ms grid excludes MethOH/pfo/geos@-5'; stims_per_fly_tables.tex: 'MethOH @ -2.0 is excluded throughout'): the solvent, methanol and geos at 10^-5 are not odors of the manuscript's matrix
stimuli.pooled_why: her mean table pools each odor's two concentrations under one name (no fly received both)
stimuli.names: Remy's names mapped onto the ORN input's (olfdb's odors table, abbreviation or alias; `odor_map`): PAA -> paa, 1-prop -> 1-3ol, every other name unchanged; every table names odors by the input's names

measures.verdict: the cosine distance of the manuscript's cells: the mean table's column kc-cosine-rmap_nls_cluster (figure-05/resampled/tidy_abbrev_dists.tsv), the measure of the control flies' 0.93 and the family's 0.50
measures.beside: the correlation distance of the same cells (kc-correlation-rmap_nls_cluster)
measures.band_rule: close: 0.7 or less; apart: 0.85 or more; middle between. The band of the verdict is the cosine distance's when the correlation distance falls in the same band, else 'middle' (the outcome is then read on the pairs' order alone)
measures.remy_matrix_for_rho: her mean table's kc-cosine-rmap_nls_cluster (pooled concentrations, as the manuscript's); kc-correlation-rmap_nls_cluster beside (partner 'correlation'); the mean over flies of her per-fly matrices (pairs held by MIN_FLIES or more) beside (partner 'fly_mean')
measures.per_fly: xrds_stim_rdm_concat.nc (before her quality control) at cell_mask_coord rmap_nls_cluster, each metric, with the manuscript's drop list ({'cell_mask_coord': 'rmap_nls_cluster', 'metric': 'correlation', 'qc_thresh': 0.3}) applied to both metrics, so that both are read on the same flies and stimuli; checked against the manuscript's per-fly correlation file (xrda_stim_rdm_concat__rmap_nls_cluster__correlation__0.3.nc), which it must equal
measures.orn_input: the ORN input alone as the program reads the model's input: 1 - Pearson across the 36 glomeruli of the lab's input (`H.apl16_orn_deltas`' rows; validation2's DL4 and VM4 left out, as in the input), of validation2_orn_deltas() (22 odors) or megamat_orn_deltas() (17 odors); cosine beside (partner 'orn_cosine'); Remy's own ORN columns (orn-correlation-01234, orn-cosine-01234, her 5 manuscript flies) a cross-check beside, deciding nothing
measures.model: cosine distance on spike counts with APL on (raw counts, the program's primary model matrix); the family is the mean over its eight wirings of the pair distances (E72's population), each wiring given beside

known.s231: the 22 odors of the validation2 panel (her mean table, the manuscript grid)

sets.s136_s153: Remy's sets of 136 and 153 pairs (17 and 18 odors; figure-05 file names). The manifests do not name their odors. `identify_sets` identifies them after this lock is committed and before any KC or ORN distance is read, from her mean table's odor columns and its non-neural columns only (the column groups ['chem_cols', 'metacyc_cols', 'vcf_cols_remy', 'vcf_cols_anoop', 'vcf_cols_remy_hmds_329', 'vcf_cols_remy_hmds_452', 'lotus_cols'] of column_groups.yaml; no kc-, orn- or model column parsed): per column, the largest set of odors all of whose pairs are non-missing (odors removed one at a time, the one with most missing pairs first, ties by name); per group, the intersection over its columns; and the intersection over all of them. A set of n odors (17, 18) is identified when exactly one distinct n-odor set arises; otherwise it is 'not identified'
sets.carrying: ρ over 'her pairs' is read on the 136 (identified), with the 153 and the 231 beside; if the 136 is not identified, on the 231, and the note says so
sets.pb: the pairs of paa and B-myr: the pairs of the carrying set involving paa or B-myr (if the carrying set lacks either odor, those of the 231)
sets.four: the pairs of the four odors: those of the set involving paa, B-myr, euc or -aPine; the 6 pairs among the four given as values
sets.min_flies_why: a pair enters a per-fly statistic (the mean over flies, the halves, the per-concentration readings) when MIN_FLIES or more flies' matrices hold it; 12 of the 231 pairs are held by 2 or 3 flies (the stimulus table, after her quality control)
sets.by_concentration: euc's and -aPine's pairs by concentration from the per-fly matrices, each concentration's flies (MIN_FLIES or more), and pooled as in her mean table beside; every table with them says that 7 of her 8 flies with euc and 4 of her 9 with -aPine had the odor at 10^-2, against an ORN input recorded at 10^-1.75 and 10^-1.5; the verdict does not rest on them. ger, pooled too (5 flies at 10^-3, 5 at 10^-2, the input at 10^-2), is read pooled only, and its tables say so

halves.rule: random halves of the flies (floor(n/2) and the rest); each split's two fly means read on the pairs both halves hold (MIN_PER_HALF or more flies each) of the set, the pairs held by MIN_FLIES or more flies in all; ρ between the halves, its mean over splits; the Spearman-Brown value for all flies and its square root, the ceiling (as hong2p.stats.split_half_reliability)

megamat.reading: the mean over her 18 flies of the per-fly matrices (pairs held by MIN_FLIES or more), at the metric (preference ['cosine', 'correlation']) and cell selection (preference ['rmap_nls_cluster', 'iscell_nls', 'iscell_good_xid0', 'none'], else the first the file lists) the file holds; no quality-control list for megamat in her folder, so none applied
megamat.level: ρ of a reader against her megamat somata over the 136 pairs of the 17 megamat odors (the megamat ORN input's panel); over the 66 pairs of the 12 odors of Yang's panel beside (partner 'megamat66')
megamat.like_for_like: the validation2 ρ's that are compared with a megamat level use Remy's matrix in the metric the megamat level is read in

level_check.rule: her megamat somata against Yang's control flies (H.yang_mean_rdm('TNT3c', <metric>)), the same metric, on the 66 pairs of the 12 odors both have: the two means; flagged when they differ by more than 0.05
level_check.consequence: when flagged, the note says so beside the verdict, and the class on the pairs' order alone (as for a distance in the middle band) is given beside; the outcome is then held only if both agree

family.members: C2 (E67's rate0.068_aplboth_k2_cap3) on the hemibrain wiring and E72 part B's seven re-drawn wirings (P1 to P4, M1 to M3), each at its own fit: E83's `saved_fit` (E72's `fitted_params`, the absolute fixed_thr, wAPLKC_scale, wKCAPL_scale, wAPLPN_scale, wPNAPL_scale and kc_kc_inh of E67's and E72's fits.csv)
family.runner: E83's `build_simulator` (the runner of E93 and E98), breadth held at the lab input's (`wiring_parts(label)['breadth']`), so the APL->KC weights are the fit's (E98's choice); APL acutely off: the APL->KC and APL->bouton scales 0
family.identity: each as-fitted run reproduces the saved fit's spike counts and responses on the odors its panel shares with the fit's panel (validation2: paa, -aPine, euc, B-myr; megamat: the 12) with 0 differences, APL on and off; a failure stops part B
family.fitted: as fitted: the fit's parameters, nothing re-tuned (carries the verdict)
family.held: re-held: E77's `hold_rates` on the panel (the somatic threshold bisected with APL off to the wiring's own APL-off fraction on its fit panel, target_off / size, then the tied APL scales to the control flies' response rate, the registry's ctrl_frac, 6.8 %, with APL on), the counts rounded on the panel's KCs x odors; partner 'held'
family.per_wiring: each wiring's own class given beside (descriptive)

outcome_rules.quantities: d = the distance of paa from B-myr (verdict measure); pb(r) = ρ of reader r against Remy's validation2 matrix over the pairs of paa and B-myr; all(r) = over the carrying set; mm(r) = r's megamat level; readers: the ORN input alone ('orn') and the family ('fam')
outcome_rules.orders: orn_orders: pb(orn) >= mm(orn) - ORDER_TOL; fam_orders_pb: pb(fam) >= mm(fam) - ORDER_TOL; fam_orders_all: all(fam) >= mm(fam) - ORDER_TOL
outcome_rules.classes: band close -> (a). Otherwise: fam_orders_pb and fam_orders_all -> (d); else orn_orders and not fam_orders_pb -> (b); else not orn_orders and not fam_orders_pb -> (c); else 'none' (the family orders the pairs of paa and B-myr but not the panel). In the middle band the class is read on the pairs' order alone (the same rules without the distance)
outcome_rules.held: the class holds when the carrying reading and every partner ['held', 'other_set', 'megamat66', 'fly_mean', 'correlation', 'orn_cosine'] give it (and, if the level check is flagged, the class on order alone too); otherwise 'reading-dependent', naming the partners that differ. Partners: held (the re-held family); other_set (the 231 when the 136 carries, the 136 when the 231 carries and the 136 is identified); megamat66 (the megamat levels on the 66 pairs); fly_mean (Remy's mean over flies in place of her mean table, for d and the ρ's); correlation (Remy's correlation distance for the ρ's, the megamat level read likewise); orn_cosine (the ORN input as cosine distance)

definitions.realism: the family's response rates with APL on and acutely off (two or more spikes), their ratio, the per-odor response fractions, the distribution of odors per KC (OPK_EDGES' classes over the panel's odors) and the largest spike counts, on each panel and reading, per wiring and for the population; no band applied; Remy's files hold distances only, so her response rates are not beside them
